note: Bundled sound library (SFX0, 31 Oct 2026; docs/plans/produced/sound-fx-spike.md). Built by scripts/sfx-synth/build-library.mjs from Kenney CC0 packs, Freesound CC0 sounds and sounds made for precut; sources, uploaders and edits in LICENSES.md. Ids never change: saved edits store them. hidden: retired sounds that still play in saved edits but are not offered. category: the browser group; tags: free words for search. role places a sound at its level against the edit's voice (hit, accent, ui, ambience). Measured from the shipped file: hitS is where it lands (the onset of its loudest 10 ms), punchDb its loudest 50 ms RMS (dBFS), both as src/main/sound-design.ts measureSoundShape; lufs is the loudest 400 ms BS.1770 momentary loudness; truePeakDb the true peak (dBTP). Visible sounds are 48 kHz Ogg Vorbis, levelled by role (loudest 50 ms at hit -6, accent -12, ui -18 dBFS) under a -1 dBTP ceiling, channels as the source.
